docs.text:
• Deployment modes – the same chemistry in four delivery forms; only startup changes between them.
  • Validation – where t_ign = 1.1075 ms comes from, and the gates behind it.
  • Known limitations – the edges this pattern runs inside: one thread, Float64 arrays, and what to do about each.

docs.title: Deployment modes
docs.text: One Fortran source, four delivery forms. The bridge calls do not change between them; what changes is how the Julia code behind those calls reaches the machine – interpreted from a project environment, precompiled into a sysimage the embedded runtime loads, or compiled ahead of time into a plain shared library – and, at the end of the line, not using Julia at all. That fourth form, native pure Fortran, is the baseline the other three are measured against.

docs.title: The spectrum
docs.text:
Measured on the capstone reacting-flow example (full report: examples/07_capstone/PERFORMANCE.md):

Mode Startup What the target machine needs Julia on the target? JIT (embedded, project env) 17.3 s init your binary, a pinned Julia install, the project env and its package depot yes Sysimage 1.90 s init your binary plus the sysimage file, built by the same Julia yes AOT library 0.58–1.97 s library init your binary plus the compiled .so no Native (pure Fortran) none your binary no

As a ladder: 17.3 s from cold start to first result in JIT, 1.90 s with a sysimage, and the AOT build answers its first call in about 12 μs, approaching the native baseline of having no Julia in the process at all. (The 12 μs is a trivial call into the compiled library; a first real chemistry call costs milliseconds of solver work in every mode, because the work sets that number, not the mode.)

Startup ranges across runs on one machine: JIT 15.1–20.2 s (it loads about 92 package caches; the high end is a busy machine), sysimage 0.93–2.37 s (the low end with a warm page cache), AOT 0.58–1.97 s (cold-to-warm page cache on the library).

docs.title: What changes and what does not
docs.text:
Startup changes; per-call cost does not. A warm call crosses the same fcj_* ABI in every mode, so the numbers from Two SDKs, two speeds hold everywhere: ~815 ns generic, ~3.8 ns on the Fast Path. The capstone’s chemistry totals show it empirically – 4.79 s (JIT) against 4.02 s (sysimage) over the same 5216 Strang half-steps, a gap that flips sign between runs. It is machine-load noise (about ±20%), not a mode effect. Pick a mode for startup latency and for what ships; do not pick it for steady-state speed.

Memory does not change either: the sysimage run’s peak RSS lands within ~30 MB of the JIT run. The image precompiles code; it does not shrink the heap your problem needs.

docs.title: Mode 1: JIT – the developer default
docs.text:
Initialize with julia_init() or julia_init_ex(project_path=...) and let Julia load precompiled package caches from a depot at runtime. No extra build steps, every package resolves through its [compat] bounds, and a top-level julia_eval_string can redefine code live. The price is the 17.3 s-class startup, and a target machine that carries the whole depot.

When project_path is omitted, julia_init_ex probes for the FortranBridge package: the $JULIA_FJ_PROJECT environment variable, then the copy installed next to the executable, then $JULIA_PROJECT. A failed probe returns without initializing, the reason in get_last_error_message().

docs.title: Mode 2: sysimage – pay at build time, load in two seconds
docs.text:
cmake -DFJ_BUILD_SYSIMAGE=ON drives scripts/build_sysimage.jl: PackageCompiler’s create_sysimage over FortranBridge, SciMLBase, OrdinaryDiffEq, and FjKinetics, tracing a precompile workload into the image. The result is a large file – about a gigabyte for this repository’s SciML-laden image – that the embedded runtime loads at init. Nothing compiles at runtime, by construction: the code is already in the image.

The capstone driver switches between the first two modes with one branch, from examples/07_capstone/1_reacting_flow.f90:

            if (trim(jmode) == 'sysimage') then
                inquire(file=trim(image_path), exist=lex)
                if (.not. lex) then
                    write (error_unit, '(a)') 'FATAL: sysimage not found at ' // &
                        trim(image_path) // ' (set FJ_SCIML_SYSIMAGE)'
                    error stop 1
                end if
                print '(a,a,a,a)', 'detonation: julia mode=sysimage image=', trim(image_path), &
                    ' project=', trim(project_path)
                call julia_init_ex(image_path=trim(image_path), project_path=trim(project_path))
            else
                print '(a,a,a)', 'detonation: julia mode=jit project=', trim(project_path)
                call julia_init_ex(project_path=trim(project_path))
            end if

Two caveats. The image is baked for cpu_target="native" – the build host’s instruction set – so it is a single-host artifact. And it is pinned to the exact Julia build: the same self-contained 1.12.7 binary must build the image and embed the runtime; a version shim pointing at another minor version is rejected by the sysimage build guard (Installation).

In sysimage mode the image already binds the precompiled modules in Main, so the runtime import the JIT path needs simply does not run. The capstone counts 13 init/setup bridge calls in sysimage mode against 15 in JIT, and the difference is that missing import sequence: the import FjKinetics eval plus the re-probe that follows it.

docs.title: Mode 3: AOT – Julia as an ordinary shared library
docs.text:
Here the direction flips: instead of Fortran embedding Julia, PackageCompiler’s create_library compiles a Julia package and its whole dependency closure into dist/, exposing your functions as C symbols. Fortran links the result like any C library, and the target needs no Julia install, no depot, no project. Startup is a plain image load (0.58–1.97 s, cold-to-warm cache), and a first call into the library answers in ~12 μs. Nothing JITs, ever.

The bridge is not involved in this mode, and that has a sharp edge: the SDK’s julia_init() must not be used. The interface note from examples/04_performance/1_jit_vs_aot.f90:

        ! Lifecycle of the runtime embedded in libmylib.so. The SDK's
        ! julia_init() must NOT be used in this mode: linking libmylib.so
        ! makes its bundled libjulia satisfy libjulia.so.1 for the whole
        ! process, and a bare jl_init() would then look for a default
        ! sys.so that the bundled layout does not ship (the sysimage is
        ! compiled INTO libmylib.so and only init_julia() knows how to
        ! load it, with an explicit bindir).
        subroutine init_julia(argc, argv) bind(c, name="init_julia")
            use iso_c_binding
            integer(c_int), value :: argc
            type(c_ptr), value :: argv
        end subroutine

        subroutine shutdown_julia(retcode) bind(c, name="shutdown_julia")
            use iso_c_binding
            integer(c_int), value :: retcode
        end subroutine

The same first call, both worlds (same source, two builds):

#ifdef COMPILED_MODE
    res = my_add_float(10.0d0, 20.0d0)
#else
    res_obj = julia%call("perf_add_one", 10.0d0)
    res = res_obj%as_real()
#endif

Error handling changes shape too: no Julia exception can cross a C ABI. The compiled library returns integer codes instead – the capstone’s AOT chemistry kernel uses 0 for success, -1 for a bad n, -2 for a solver that was never built, -3 for a solver that threw – and its buffers are wrapped zero-copy, exactly like the bridge’s fcj_wrap_array.

Two costs to know before choosing it. The build is heavy: the non-incremental codegen of the whole closure took about 50 min wall and ~33 GB peak compiler RSS for the capstone kernel, and dist/ ships about 2.5 GB. And the API surface freezes: you call fixed C symbols, not names resolved at runtime.

One sentence of PackageCompiler hygiene: build with include_lazy_artifacts=true, or the “self-contained” library will silently download lazy artifacts (MKL among them) from the network the first time it loads on a machine without a depot.

Working examples: examples/03_deployment/2_compiled_library/ (the small demo) and examples/07_capstone/3_aot_kinetics/ (the production-shaped one).

docs.title: Mode 4: native – the yardstick
docs.text: Pure Fortran, nothing embedded. It belongs in the table because it is the reference: every bridge mode is validated against a native run of the same physics – four acceptance gates, zero deviations, residuals below 1e-12 (Validation). When a workload buys nothing from Julia, native is not a fallback; it is the answer.

docs.title: Startup control: julia_init_ex
docs.text:
All three embedded modes start through the same SDK call, which wraps the C entry point fcj_init_ex (as julia_shutdown wraps fcj_shutdown). Its optional arguments are the deployment knobs: image_path (the sysimage), project_path (the environment), nthreads (Julia threads), handle_signals (disposition). From examples/03_deployment/ex_init_options.f90:

    ! 1. Initialize the Julia runtime with explicit startup options:
    !    - project_path: omitted on purpose -- the exe-adjacent probe finds
    !      the FortranBridge package copied next to this executable by the
    !      build, and an explicit RELATIVE path would be validated against
    !      the CWD (breaking runs from any other directory)
    !    - nthreads = 2
    !    - handle_signals = 0 ("no takeover": SIGINT/SIGTERM are reset to
    !      SIG_DFL after init; GC-critical handlers stay intact -- bridge.h)
    call julia_init_ex(nthreads=2, handle_signals=0)

Failure semantics are deliberate: a bad option (a path too long to fit, an environment that does not exist) returns without initializing and get_last_error_message() carries the reason – the process does not abort. On signals: the bridge never touches jl_options.handle_signals, because GC safepoint polling depends on Julia’s own handlers; the 0 above means “no takeover”, resetting SIGINT/SIGTERM to their defaults after init. The legacy julia_init / julia_init_with_image keep their historical signal behavior.

docs.title: Choosing
docs.text:
1. Develop in JIT. Nothing to build, live redefinition, the whole stack resolvable through [compat]. The 17.3 s-class startup is a development tax, paid on a machine that can afford it.
  2. Cut startup with a sysimage when the same binary runs repeatedly on a known host. 1.90 s to first result, identical heap footprint, no runtime compilation by construction. Budget the image size, and remember it is host-pinned and Julia-version-pinned.
  3. Go AOT when the target has no Julia, or when first-call latency is the product. Nothing to install, ~12 μs first call, integer error codes instead of exceptions – and a heavy one-time build you schedule in advance, not stumble into.
  4. Stay native where Julia buys nothing. The baseline is also a mode.

docs.title: Your first call
docs.text: The shortest complete program – start the runtime, load a Julia file, call a function, unbox the result, shut down – is examples/01_basics/1_quickstart.f90, built as ex01_quickstart. This page walks it step by step. Build it first if you have not: Installation.

docs.title: The whole program
docs.text:
program ex01_quickstart
    use julia_high_level
    implicit none

    type(JuliaValue) :: julia ! Helper object for method dispatch
    type(JuliaValue) :: res
    real(kind=8) :: sum_result

    ! 1. Initialize the Julia Runtime
    call julia_init()

    ! 2. Load your Julia Code
    call julia_include_exe_relative("examples_lib.jl")
    call julia_eval_string('using .ExamplesLib')

    ! 3. Call a simple function: greet(name)
    !    Equivalent to Julia: res = ExamplesLib.greet("Fortran User")
    res = julia%call("ExamplesLib.greet", "Fortran User")

    ! 4. Call a calculation function: add_numbers(x, y)
    !    Equivalent to Julia: res = ExamplesLib.add_numbers(10.5, 20.0)
    res = julia%call("ExamplesLib.add_numbers", 10.5d0, 20.0d0)

    ! Convert the result back to Fortran real (Unboxing)
    sum_result = res%as_real()
    print *, "Result of 10.5 + 20.0 = ", sum_result

    ! 5. Shutdown
    call julia_shutdown()

end program ex01_quickstart

(The repository source also prints a banner and checks that ExamplesLib loaded; trimmed here, unchanged otherwise.)

docs.title: Step 1: initialize
docs.text:
julia_init() wraps the C entry point fcj_init and starts the embedded Julia runtime inside your process – no separate Julia process, no pipe. Two rules come with it:

  • One runtime per process, and all bridge calls stay on the thread that initialized it. Initialize from the thread that will do the calling (the main thread in every example).
  • Re-initialization after julia_shutdown() is not supported; init once.

For startup control – sysimage path, project environment, thread count, signal disposition – use julia_init_ex instead; see Deployment modes.

docs.title: Step 2: load your Julia code
docs.text:
julia_include_exe_relative("examples_lib.jl") includes a Julia file resolved relative to the executable, not the current working directory – the build copied examples_lib.jl next to the binary, so the example runs from anywhere. julia_eval_string then brings the module into scope. The loaded file defines, among others:

function greet(name::String)
    println("Julia says: Hello, $name!")
    return "Greeting received"
end

function add_numbers(x::Float64, y::Float64)
    return x + y
end

docs.title: Steps 3 and 4: call, then unbox
docs.text:
julia%call(name, args...) looks the function up by name and boxes the arguments automatically: real to Float64, integer to Int, string to String, logical to Bool, complex to ComplexF64. The result is a JuliaValue handle – rooted in the bridge’s C-side root set, so the Julia garbage collector cannot reclaim it while you hold it.

%as_real() unboxes into a plain Fortran real. Its siblings: %as_integer(), %as_logical(), %as_complex(), %as_string().

docs.title: Step 5: shut down
docs.text: julia_shutdown() wraps fcj_shutdown and tears the runtime down cleanly. Fast Path function pointers are invalid after it (see Two SDKs, two speeds).

docs.title: When something fails
docs.text:
Failures are not silent. Every bridge call is exception-checked; a failed call returns an invalid handle, and get_last_error_message() carries the Julia error text back to Fortran. From examples/01_basics/1_hello_world.f90:

    res = dummy%call("non_existent_func", 123)

    if (.not. res%is_valid()) then
        err_msg = get_last_error_message()
        print *, "[Fortran] Caught expected error: ", err_msg
    endif

docs.title: Run it
docs.text:
./examples/ex01_quickstart

--- Example 1: Quickstart (Standard Workflow) ---
Julia says: Hello, Fortran User!
Result of 10.5 + 20.0 =    30.500000000000000

The first run pays Julia runtime startup plus JIT compilation of everything it touches. For this trivial example that is seconds; for the SciML-laden capstone the same cold start measures 17.3 s (Deployment modes shows the sysimage cutting it to 1.90 s).

docs.title: Installation
docs.text: FortranCallJulia builds on Linux with gfortran, gcc, and CMake, embedding a pinned Julia 1.12.7 runtime in-process. The C bridge, the two-tier Fortran SDK, and the Julia-side runtime package (FortranBridge.jl) all come from this repository – there is nothing else to download. Two entries in the matrix below are load-bearing pins; the sections after the table explain why they are not negotiable.

docs.title: Version matrix
docs.text:
Component Version Notes OS Linux The only platform exercised by the acceptance suite. Compilers gfortran + gcc GNU-specific flags (-fno-underscoring) are compiler-gated in CMake. CMake 3.13 or newer Drives the bridge, the SDK, and the examples. Julia 1.12.7, pinned The embedded libjulia; see the next section. Catalyst ~16.2 (major 16) Compat-pinned via FjKinetics.jl’s [compat]. OrdinaryDiffEq ~6.111 (major 6) Compat-pinned; the 7.x line is a measured ~700x regression. SciMLBase ~2.155 (major 2) Compat-pinned alongside the two above. ChemMechSim.jl v1.2.0 Open source; the version every validation number here was produced with.

Only the first four rows are needed to build and run the basics examples. The SciML pins and ChemMechSim matter once you build the sysimage or the chemistry capstone (examples/07_capstone).

docs.title: Julia 1.12.7, pinned on purpose
docs.text:
The bridge embeds libjulia 1.12.7, and every acceptance baseline must run exactly that version – the same runtime, or the comparison is meaningless. The pin is not cosmetic. During this project’s development a juliaup shim silently drifted to a newer minor release, the comparison baselines followed the shim, and the version mismatch masqueraded as a bridge regression: a defect hunt aimed at code that was never broken. Since then the version is pinned and actively checked – the sysimage build refuses to run under anything but Julia 1.12.x.

Install a self-contained Julia 1.12.7 and make sure julia on PATH resolves to it:

julia --version        # must report: julia version 1.12.7

With juliaup, pin the default explicitly, because the shim’s default can change under you:

juliaup add 1.12.7
juliaup default 1.12.7
julia --version

A plain tarball install works equally well. Whichever route you take: the same binary must later build any sysimage you load (Deployment modes).

docs.title: The SciML stack, compat-pinned
docs.text:
examples/07_capstone/FjKinetics/Project.toml pins the solve stack through [compat]: Catalyst ~16.2, OrdinaryDiffEq ~6.111, SciMLBase ~2.155 – the major-16 / major-6 / major-2 lines. Resolve through those pins and do not force an upgrade past them. The reason is measured, not aesthetic: with the stack left unpinned, a resolve once drifted onto the OrdinaryDiffEq 7.x line, whose step-size controller degraded the per-grid-cell reinit!/step! pattern by roughly 700x (a frozen cell costing hundreds of internal steps instead of one). The pins live in the package, so a normal resolve respects them; you only break them by force-upgrading.

The one-time environment setup is scripted. scripts/install_sciml_env.jl creates the scratch environment scripts/sysimage_env, develops the in-repo packages into it (FortranBridge.jl, FjKinetics.jl v0.2, plus ChemMechSim – next section), adds the SciML stack, and then wires FjKinetics’ own package environment. Run it with the same pinned Julia:

julia scripts/install_sciml_env.jl

docs.title: ChemMechSim.jl
docs.text:
ChemMechSim.jl supplies mechanism input – GRI-Mech 3.0 with 53 species and 325 reactions – and is open source, installable as a normal Julia package:

import Pkg
Pkg.add("ChemMechSim")
Pkg.status("ChemMechSim")

Every validation number in these docs was produced with v1.2.0. The General registry can lag behind the repository (it has carried v1.0.0 while the repository was already at v1.2.0), so if Pkg.status reports something older, install the tagged v1.2.0 from a checkout of the repository instead:

Pkg.develop(path="<your ChemMechSim.jl checkout>")   # at tag v1.2.0

scripts/install_sciml_env.jl expects such a checkout and develops it into both environments it sets up; if yours is not in the default location, point CHEMMECHSIM_PATH at it before running the script. Whichever way you installed it, confirm the version inside scripts/sysimage_env before comparing your results against the validation numbers.

docs.title: Build
docs.text:
From a checkout of this repository:

mkdir build && cd build
cmake -DBUILD_EXAMPLES=ON ..
make -j8
./examples/ex01_quickstart

At configure time CMake finds julia on PATH – failing immediately with a clear message if it is missing – and asks julia-config.jl for the C and linker flags that match your Julia build. The build produces libfcj_middleware.a (eight C bridge sources plus the two Fortran SDK sources) and links it statically into each example executable; the FortranBridge runtime directory and examples_lib.jl are copied next to the executables, so examples run from any working directory.

For the optional sysimage build, which cuts the SciML cold start from 17.3 s to 1.90 s:

julia scripts/install_sciml_env.jl    # once; see the SciML section above
cmake -DFJ_BUILD_SYSIMAGE=ON ..
make fcj_sysimage                     # minutes; downloads on first run

docs.title: Consuming from another CMake project
docs.text:
The library exports one namespaced CMake target, fcj::fcj_middleware, through two tiers. Both need the same pinned Julia 1.12.x at configure time – the package re-runs Julia discovery on your machine (Julia on PATH, or -DJULIA_EXECUTABLE=...) and rejects a different minor, because the bridge embeds libjulia 1.12.7.

find_package – install once, then consume the install tree:

find_package(FortranCallJulia 0.1 REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(your_app PRIVATE fcj::fcj_middleware)

Configure with -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/path/to/installed/prefix. One caveat: the installed Fortran modules under include/ were compiled by the builder’s gfortran – consume them with the same gfortran version, or use FetchContent to compile everything with your own.

FetchContent – no install step; compile the bridge inside your tree and pin a tag:

include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(fcj
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/openEarthModelling/FortranCallJulia.git
    GIT_TAG        v0.1.0)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(fcj)
target_link_libraries(your_app PRIVATE fcj::fcj_middleware)

At runtime the bridge locates the FortranBridge Julia package via JULIA_FJ_PROJECT or a directory next to the executable. With find_package the Config sets FortranCallJulia_FortranBridge_DIR to the installed copy; with FetchContent it is <fcj-source>/src/FortranBridge. Both tiers are exercised in CI by tests/cmake_consumer.

docs.title: Known limitations
docs.text:
Four edges, stated plainly. None of them is news hidden here – the thread rule and the array types already shaped the patterns you met in Arrays and callbacks – but this page is the honest list in one place, each item with what it costs and the move that works today.

# Limitation The move that works today 1 Bridge calls pinned to the init thread batch: one call, all cells 2 Array channel Float64 / ComplexF64 only keep bulk data real(c_double); scalars are unbounded 3 Linux + gcc/gfortran centric nothing else is claimed 4 No ctest automation run the example gates by hand

docs.title: 1. All bridge calls are pinned to the init thread
docs.text:
One runtime per process, initialized by fcj_init / fcj_init_ex on the calling thread – and every subsequent fcj_* call (a wrap, an extraction, an eval, a callback invocation) must stay on that same thread. The blunt consequence: OpenMP parallelism hits a wall. A !$omp parallel do loop whose body crosses the bridge is calling from a non-init thread, which is outside everything the bridge supports. Re-initialization after fcj_shutdown is not supported either: one lifecycle per process.

What works is inverting the parallelism. Pack every cell into one wrapped buffer and make ONE call; Julia does the looping, on as many threads as you asked for at init (julia_init_ex(nthreads=N)). That is the whole design of examples/05_hpc_parallel/1_multithreading.f90 – 100,000 matrices wrapped once, one call – and of the capstone’s chemistry, one batched step_chemistry! per Strang half-step (Bring your own kinetics). Fortran-side threads stay fine for any region that makes no bridge calls.

docs.title: 2. The array channel carries Float64 and ComplexF64 only
docs.text:
The zero-copy channel has exactly two element types. Wrapping takes contiguous real(c_double) memory; %to_fortran fills a real or complex buffer. An integer array or a Float32 array does not wrap – there is no conversion layer in between, because the point of the channel is that nothing gets converted.

Scalars are not so bounded: every scalar type boxes (Two SDKs, two speeds). So the workaround is ordinary Fortran hygiene: bulk numeric data lives in real(c_double) targets – which it usually does anyway – and everything small crosses as a scalar.

docs.title: 3. Linux + gcc/gfortran centric
docs.text: The bridge is developed and validated on Linux, built with CMake, compiled with gcc/gfortran, speaking standard bind(c). Nothing here has been tested on macOS or Windows, with non-GNU compilers, or against Julia builds outside the pinned 1.12.x line. Standard bind(c) and iso_c_binding mean it may well work elsewhere – but nothing is claimed on this site that was not actually run.

docs.title: 4. No ctest automation
docs.text: The acceptance gates are real but manual. They are example executables that print loud PASS sentinels (EX_CAPSTONE_GRI_IGNITION_PASS and siblings) and exit nonzero on failure – and ctest drives none of them. If you change the bridge, you run the gates yourself: build the examples, run them, watch for the sentinels. What the gates check is documented in Validation; the full inventory is laid out in the developer’s acceptance gates page.

docs.title: Two SDKs, two speeds
docs.text: Fortran reaches the bridge through two modules, and they are layers, not rivals. julia_low_level (src/julia_binding.f90) is the bind(c) truth: an interface block declaring the fcj_* C ABI, roughly 105 symbols, nothing on top. julia_high_level (src/julia_sdk.f90) builds on it: JuliaValue handles with GC-safe lifetimes, automatic boxing, converters, and batch extraction (%to_fortran). You can mix them in one program – the high level uses the low level, and its get_function_pointer helper is the recommended way into the pointer path further down.

docs.title: Positioning
docs.text: julia_high_level julia_low_level Source src/julia_sdk.f90 src/julia_binding.f90 Shape OOP: type(JuliaValue) with type-bound procedures bind(c) declarations of the fcj_* C ABI (~105 symbols) Arguments auto-boxing (real to Float64, string to String, …) you box or pass c_ptr yourself Lifetime GC-safe: assignment retains, finalizers release exactly once manual fcj_retain / fcj_release Results %as_real() and siblings, %element / %property, %to_fortran batch copy raw type(c_ptr), you unbox Errors invalid handle + get_last_error_message() return codes + get_last_error_message() Best for application glue, exploration, anything not per-iteration direct ABI access, unwrapped symbols, minimal layering

docs.title: The same call, both ways
docs.text:
High level, from examples/01_basics/1_quickstart.f90:

    res = julia%call("ExamplesLib.add_numbers", 10.5d0, 20.0d0)
    sum_result = res%as_real()

Low level, the declaration your compiler sees in src/julia_binding.f90:

    function fcj_call1_float64(func_name, arg1) bind(c, name="fcj_call1_float64") result(res)
        import :: c_char, c_double, c_ptr
        character(kind=c_char), dimension(*), intent(in) :: func_name
        real(kind=c_double), value :: arg1
        type(c_ptr) :: res
    end function fcj_call1_float64

The c_ptr result is not rooted for you: to keep the object alive across further bridge calls you must fcj_retain it and fcj_release it exactly once when done. That bookkeeping is precisely what JuliaValue gives you for free – which is why the high level is the default recommendation.

docs.title: The numbers
docs.text:
Path Per call What it buys Fast Path: raw C function pointer ~3.8 ns no name lookup, no boxing, no exception check Generic typed call ~815 ns any function, any arguments, full error checking

Both figures are 100k-iteration averages, produced by examples/04_performance/2_call_overhead.f90. Read them as the price of generality: the generic path resolves the name, boxes every argument, unboxes the result, and checks for a Julia exception on each hop. Against any real workload – an inv(), an ODE step – 800 ns is noise. Against a per-grid-cell call inside a hydrodynamics loop, it is not.

docs.title: The Fast Path
docs.text:
When the same bitstype-signature function is called in a tight loop, drop to a raw function pointer registered once. From examples/04_performance/2_call_overhead.f90 (timing scaffolding elided; the ~3.8 ns call-site comment added here):

    abstract interface
        function func_add_one(val) bind(c)
            import :: c_double
            real(c_double), value :: val
            real(c_double) :: func_add_one
        end function func_add_one
    end interface

    procedure(func_add_one), pointer :: c_func => null()

    raw_ptr = get_function_pointer("perf_add_one", "Float64", "Float64")
    call c_f_procpointer(raw_ptr, c_func)

    do i = 1, N
        y = c_func(x)            ! ~3.8 ns: a plain C call, nothing else
    end do

The registry roots the underlying @cfunction in Main, so GC lifetime is safe – but the contract has hard edges, and misuse crashes the process with no Julia-side diagnostic:

  1. Register after the final definition. The trampoline captures the function object at registration; rebinding the name later (for example to a closure) leaves old pointers calling the captured object.
  2. Re-registering a name invalidates earlier pointers for that name; discard them.
  3. The called function must not throw. An exception unwinding through the C trampoline frame is undefined behavior, typically a segfault; handle errors inside Julia or return a sentinel.
  4. Types must match exactly – ret_type / arg_types bitstypes only; nothing is validated at registration.
  5. Pointers die with the runtime: invalid after julia_shutdown().

docs.title: Which one, when
docs.text:
1. Default to julia_high_level. Correctness and GC safety first; the ~815 ns generic path is negligible next to any computation worth crossing the bridge for. Application glue, result navigation, one-off calls: stay here.
  2. Drop to julia_low_level when you need the C ABI itself – an fcj_* symbol the SDK does not wrap, minimal layering over the bridge, or a context where the OOP layer does not fit. You take over retain/release bookkeeping; mistakes leak or dangle.
  3. In a tight loop, use neither – use the Fast Path (or hoist the call out of the loop entirely). If the signature is bitstype-fixed and the body cannot throw, get_function_pointer plus c_f_procpointer gets you to ~3.8 ns per call. This is how per-grid-cell chemistry stays cheap in the capstone.

docs.title: 门清单
docs.text:
哨兵串 示例 检查 SOD_VALIDATION_PASS 07_capstone/1_reacting_flow.f90（sod 模式） Sod 管与精确 Riemann 解 DETONATION_VALIDATION_PASS 07_capstone/1_reacting_flow.f90（detonation 模式） CJ 爆震速度 vs 解析 Chapman–Jouguet 值 EX_CAPSTONE_GRI_IGNITION_PASS 07_capstone/2_gri_ignition.f90 对原生 Julia 跑的四个门控量（下文） DEMO_PASS 06_sciml/3_sciml_demo.f90 SciML 回调 demo 端到端

爆震门是物理头条检查：nx = 2700 时算得的前沿速度为 7.12391，解析 CJ 速度 7.12470——偏差 0.011%，燃烧态距 CJ 在 0.025% 以内（u 0.025%、 p 0.023%、rho 0.018%）。（nx = 400 时同一道门以 +8.53% 响亮失败并说明 原因：欠解析是错误，不是通过。）

docs.title: 四量 GRI 门
docs.text:
2_gri_ignition.f90 门的不是一个数而是四个，容差相同——点火延迟 t_ign（1.1075 ms）、末端温度 T_end、以及两个专门钉死布局敏感的 4 x 2001 列主序矩阵提取的摩尔分数抽查值（t = 0 的 CH4、t_end 的 CO2）。判决块逐字摘自 examples/07_capstone/2_gri_ignition.f90：

    rel = abs(t_ign_f - t_ign_nat) / t_ign_nat
    rel_t = abs(T(NSAMPLE) - t_end_nat) / t_end_nat
    rel_x1 = abs(x_at(1, 1) - x_ch4_nat) / x_ch4_nat
    rel_x2 = abs(x_at(3, NSAMPLE) - x_co2_nat) / x_co2_nat
    ...
    if (rel < REL_TOL .and. rel_t < REL_TOL .and. rel_x1 < REL_TOL &
        .and. rel_x2 < REL_TOL) then
        print *, 'EX_CAPSTONE_GRI_IGNITION_PASS'

其中 REL_TOL = 1.0e-8_c_double。在正确钉死的运行时下，四个偏差恰好 为 0，全轨迹叠合审计的最坏序列残差低于 1e-12（实测 ~8.3e-13，落在最陡 的 CO2 上升段）。两个 X 门是布局绊线：列主序展平一旦出错，X(1,1) 读 到的就是别的物种，门以数量级失败，而不是以边缘失败。

注意门控的是什么：收敛标量，不是逐点轨迹。同一刚性系统的两次独立求解， 即使在同一运行时下，过渡段的少数点也会差在末位；逐点设门必然 flake， 而这四个标量稳定。门又足够紧，以至于错误的运行时溜不进去——这就是下 一节。

docs.title: 跑门
docs.text:
构建时打开示例，然后先生成原生基准，再跑桥侧。配方出自 examples/07_capstone/2_gri_ignition.f90 的文件头（下面的 Julia 路径是占 位符——用你钉死的 1.12.7 二进制，不要用版本 shim）：

    cd build/examples
    <pinned-julia-1.12.7>/bin/julia --project=../../scripts/sysimage_env \
        ../../examples/07_capstone/run_gri_native.jl
    ./ex_capstone_gri_ignition

基准脚本写 gri_native.dat（四个参考值）与完整原生轨迹 output/gri_native_series.csv；可执行文件读 .dat、经桥跑同一条 FjKinetics 调用路径、取回数组，然后打印四个相对偏差加哨兵串。其余门不 需要基准步骤——它们的参考是解析的或内建的。

过期基准会被响亮抓住：可执行文件拒绝格式与当前脚本不符的 .dat，并给 出”重新生成”提示。

docs.title: 陷阱：漂移的基准让门失败、还嫁祸给桥
docs.text:
验收比较只有在两边跑同一个 Julia 时才有意义。桥可执行文件内嵌构建钉 死的 libjulia 1.12.7；原生基准却由路径上的那个 julia 生成。在 julia 实为自动更新版本 shim 的机器上，这一对悄悄错开——而失败方式很 恶劣：门把桥的取数通道报成嫌疑人，因为被测的是桥这一侧。

这不是假设，是真事。一次用指向 1.13.2 的 shim 重新生成的基准，让四道门 中的两道报出非零余量（0 / 1.74e-9 / 0 / 6.75e-9，最坏 6.75e-9）——看着 像通过，实际已中毒——而过渡窗上逐点漂移达 T rel 1.5e-5、 CH4 rel 0.54。1e-8 的门被基准错位轻松跨越，调查 却先追了求解器非确定性与线程归约顺序。用钉死二进制重新生成基准，四个偏 差一夜之间全归零。完整故事见教训；工程残留是两道守卫。

运行时守卫，逐字摘自 examples/07_capstone/run_gri_native.jl（原错误串 写的是开发者本机安装路径；此处缩短为占位符）：

const BRIDGE_JULIA = v"1.12.7"   # the libjulia the bridge executable links
VERSION == BRIDGE_JULIA || error(
    "native baseline must be generated with the bridge-pinned Julia " *
    "$BRIDGE_JULIA (this is $(VERSION)) -- use the pinned 1.12.7 binary, " *
    "not the juliaup shim. A different runtime drifts at the ignition " *
    "transition and fails the 1e-8 gates while wrongly indicting the " *
    "bridge extraction.")

构建侧的孪生兄弟是 CMakeLists.txt 里的 FJ_BUILD_SYSIMAGE 守卫：配置期 拒绝一切 1.12.x 线以外的 Julia，并把话挑明（”不要用 juliaup shim”）。

docs.title: 维护纪律
docs.text:
1. 每次都用钉死二进制重新生成基准。 守卫让任何别的选择都变得响亮。
  2. 桥改动之后跑全部四道门，不是只跑离你改动最近的那道。过去一次审查 修复引入的回归，只有新加的 X 门当场抓住——仅有 t_ign 一道门时，双 重间接的物种索引 bug 一直绿着。
  3. 看余量，不只是看哨兵串。 门会打印四个偏差；全零才是健康的稳态。 任何持续停在 1e-9 的值都意味着基准又错位了——先找运行时，再碰桥。

docs.title: 桥内部
docs.text:
8 个 C 文件、4 个职责组、1 份契约。用户侧页面从外面描述桥——fcj_* ABI、两层 Fortran SDK、那些数字。本页打开盒子：每个文件拥有什么、GC 的账 怎么还、Julia 1.12 的 C API 在哪里逼出了绕行方案。它是写给改 src/bridge/ 的维护者的；要使用桥，不需要这里任何内容。

架构页用一屏讲同一个系统；如果你是初来，先读 它。

docs.title: 八个文件
docs.text:
组 文件 拥有 核心 core.c、memory.c 生命周期（fcj_init / fcj_init_ex / fcj_shutdown）、线程钉死、GC 根集 分发与装箱 dispatch.c、types.c fcj_call* / fcj_call_kwargs、函数名缓存、标量装箱（fcj_box_*） 数组通道 arrays.c、extract.c N 维零拷贝包装、深拷贝、批量取数回 Fortran 回调访问 callbacks.c、accessors.c @cfunction 蹦床、get_field / get_property、原生 Float64 元素访问

两个头文件给它们定框。bridge.h 是公共契约：53 个 fcj_ 函数加 fcj_options_t——Fortran bind(c) 层能碰到的一切。bridge_internal.h 是私有的：原生元素访问器（fcj_get_real 及其同族）、共用助手、以及 fcj_shutdown 逐一走过的各模块清缓存钩子。全站沿用的”约 105 个导出 fcj_* 符号”这一口径数的是这些源码里整个 fcj_ 命名空间；绑定层 src/julia_binding.f90 声明其中 58 个（53 个公共函数中的 52 个—— fcj_ready 从不被绑定——加 6 个内部元素访问器），其余是从不过 ABI 的内 部助手。

docs.title: 核心：生命周期与根集
docs.text:
core.c 拥有状态机。fcj_state 是 _Atomic；每个入口先经 fcj_ready() 检查它才碰 Julia。已知限制里的线程规则在 check_thread() 里是被执行、不是被记录（逐字摘自 src/bridge/core.c）：

int check_thread() {
    if (pthread_self() != main_thread_id) {
        char msg[256];
        snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Thread Error: Julia called from thread %p, runtime owned by thread %p",
                 (void*)pthread_self(), (void*)main_thread_id);
        set_error(msg);
        return 0; // Fail
    }
    return 1; // OK
}

失败语义按入口分家：fcj_init 失败即终止进程（原始契约），而 fcj_init_ex 返回错误码、原因留在 fcj_get_last_error()——Fortran 侧以 get_last_error_message() 读到。fcj_shutdown 是单向的：状态机永不回到 READY，shutdown 之后重新初始化会被响亮拒绝，而不是被尝试。

memory.c 是 GC 的故事，它的头注释比任何转述都说得清楚（摘自 src/bridge/memory.c）：

// fcj_retain/fcj_release keep their bind(C) signatures but no longer round-trip
// through Julia (retain_obj/release_obj in GCManager.jl) on the hot path.
// Retained objects live in a Julia Vector{Any} reachable through the constant
// binding `Main.FJ_ROOTS` ... bookkeeping is a pure-C ptr -> slot hash map with
// per-pointer refcounts, mirroring GCManager's REF_COUNTS/PTR_CACHE logic.

维护者要记住的机制：

  • C static 不是 GC 根。 任何缓存进 static 的函数或值必须走 fcj_retain（模块绑定算数；裸 static 不算）。唯一被允许的例外是被 Base 绑定保活的不朽单例，例如 types.c 缓存的 ComplexF64 类型对象。
  • fcj_map 是开放寻址加墓碑与引用计数——被删条目打墓碑使探测链保 持完整；同一指针 retain 两次占一个槽、计数为二。
  • 这些 static 一处锁都没有。 单线程契约（check_thread）就是锁。 破坏契约你得到的是数据竞争，不是一个 bug 报告。

docs.title: 分发与装箱
docs.text:
dispatch.c 把名字变成调用。函数名缓存是 256 槽定长表、FNV-1a 哈希； 缓存命中经 fcj_retain 路由，缓存住的 jl_function_t* 才有根。维护者 永远不能撤销的两条失效规则：

  1. 该缓存在 fcj_shutdown 中最先被清——趁还没有任何东西能再解引用 它。
  2. 每次 julia_eval_string 都使名字缓存失效。 一次 eval 可以把 f 从函数重定义成闭包，过期缓存项会永远调用捕获的旧对象。（Fast Path 注 册表刻意保留其捕获对象语义并写明了；见 两套 SDK，两种速度。）

fcj_call1_float64 一族到 N 参版本、再到关键字参数路径 fcj_call_kwargs， 全部汇入同一条 jl_call 加异常检查的尾巴。types.c 把 Fortran 标量装 箱成 Julia 对象——fcj_box_float64、fcj_box_string 等——外加上述缓存 的 ComplexF64 数据类型。

docs.title: 数组通道
docs.text:
arrays.c 经 jl_ptr_to_array 把 Fortran 内存包装成 1 到 FCJ_MAX_NDIM 任意秩的 Julia Array，零拷贝。包装路径逐字摘自 src/bridge/arrays.c （三个守卫助手同形，为篇幅略去）：

void* fcj_wrap_array(void* data, long ndim, const long* dims) {
    if (!fcj_ready()) { set_error("Julia runtime not initialized or already shut down"); return NULL; }
    if (!check_thread()) return NULL;
    jl_value_t *array_type = NULL;
    jl_value_t *dims_tuple = NULL;
    JL_GC_PUSH2(&array_type, &dims_tuple);

    array_type = array_type_for_ndim(ndim, "fcj_wrap_array");
    ...
    dims_tuple = make_dims_tuple(ndim, dims, "fcj_wrap_array");
    ...
    jl_array_t *arr = jl_ptr_to_array(array_type, data, dims_tuple, 0);

    if (check_julia_exception()) { JL_GC_POP(); return NULL; }
    JL_GC_POP();
    return (void*)arr;
}

这段代码里看得见两条纪律，全桥处处负载：局部值在调用期间用 JL_GC_PUSH2 扎根；任何错误路径都先 set_error 原因再返回 NULL。深拷贝 兄弟 fcj_copy_array 分配全新 Julia 数组并 memcpy 进去，分配前做溢出检 查的规模乘积。

extract.c 是回程：fcj_to_fortran（一次批量拷进 Fortran 缓冲、长度校 验）、fcj_get_element、fcj_get_property。批量路径是从 jl_array_data_ 出发、带 n == len 检查的单次 memcpy——正因如此取数 通道是位级精确的，验收门才敢把 1e-8 的门摆在它面前 （验收门）。

docs.title: 回调访问
docs.text:
callbacks.c 跑另一个方向：Fortran bind(c) 子程序经 @cfunction 蹦床 包装成 Julia 可调用对象，调用上下文不透明地携带。这是 examples/06_sciml/1_callback.f90 那些 OrdinaryDiffEq 回调演示背后的机 器。用户页的硬规则在这一层同样成立：蹦床帧容不下 Julia 异常，会抛错的被 调方属未定义行为——在 Fortran 侧校验、返回哨兵值。

accessors.c 实现 %element 与 %property，而 Julia 1.12 的 C API 在 这里逼出了全树最有教益的绕行。extract.c 的头注释记录在案（摘自 src/bridge/extract.c）：

// 1.12.7 API notes (verified against include/julia/julia.h):
//  - jl_get_property does not exist; jl_get_field exists but only reads
//    plain struct fields (no getproperty overloads, no NamedTuples), so
//    the contract's fallback applies: Base.getproperty is cached once and
//    jl_call-ed, matching helper_getfield semantics in Accessors.jl;
//    getproperty dispatches on Symbol, so the name is interned with
//    jl_symbol (immortal, globally rooted) instead of boxed as a String;
//  - jl_arrayref does not exist either (removed with the Memory-backed
//    array rewrite), so element boxing goes through a cached
//    Base.getindex binding -- the same numeric boxing jl_arrayref used to
//    perform.

把它读成通用教训：当某个 jl_* 便捷函数缺席时，把等价的 Base 函数缓存 一次（经 fcj_retain 扎根）再 jl_call 它——不要手搓结构体偏移。 bridge_internal.h 补上原生元素访问器（fcj_get_real / fcj_set_real 及 2 维、3 维形态）：对包装内存的直接 Float64 读写，不装箱，供热路径 逐格使用。

docs.title: 信号与错误传输
docs.text:
桥永不写 jl_options.handle_signals：嵌入式 Julia 的 GC safepoint 轮询依 赖 Julia 自己的信号处理器，关掉它就会在 safepoint 崩溃——是必崩，不是偶 发（教训）。fcj_options_t 提供的 handle_signals = 0 含 义是不接管：init 成功后桥把 SIGINT / SIGTERM 重置为 SIG_DFL， GC 关键的处理器原封不动。

错误走一条通道：每个运行时一个 last-error 缓冲，经 fcj_get_last_error() 读出、以 get_last_error_message() 露面。Julia 侧异常在调用边界被接住、 格式化进该缓冲，调用返回无效句柄或 NULL——进程继续跑。

docs.title: 贡献指南
docs.text: 项目采用 MIT 许可证（LICENSE）——这份许可证就是全部法律安排；没有 CLA，也没有它之外的任何贡献者协议。本页讲实用的一半：怎么得到一个能工作的构建、”完成”意味着什么、一个好的改动长什么样。

docs.title: 得到能工作的构建
docs.text: 先完整走一遍安装：钉死的 Julia 1.12.x、打开示 例的 CMake、草稿环境、跑一次 quickstart。本页的一切都假设在你改任何东西 之前这一套是通的。如果改动之前就构建不起来，你先发现了一个值得报告的 bug，再谈写代码。

docs.title: 完成的定义：门
docs.text:
这个仓库里的改动，门说了算才算完，编译通过不算。按成本递增：

  1. 干净构建。 CMake 配置加构建，无新警告。
  2. 文档门。 .venv-docs/bin/mkdocs build --strict 与对拍脚本必须零警 告通过——每个页面在两个语言下都存在、标题已翻译、sync 戳一致、且没 有页面泄漏机器特征串。动了 docs/ 下任何一页，就两条都跑。
  3. 验收门。 验收门的示例门，手工跑，哨兵行全 绿。桥或提取的改动欠的是全套，不是离得最近的那个示例——过去一次修复 带着回归上线，只有布局敏感的门当场抓住。
  4. 改动够得着的产物要重建。 Julia 侧包的改动使 sysimage 与 AOT 构建失 效（从零重建）。

门是刻意手工的（已知限制）。这让它成了 你的活。

docs.title: 一个好的改动长什么样
docs.text:
范围小、按逻辑单元提交。 仓库的提交历史按一个逻辑单元一个 commit 书 写——功能、它的测试、它的示例、它的文档、它的环境变更分开提交，不是一 个大盘子落地。保持这个粒度；正是它让这里的 bisect 真的 bisect 得动。

响亮失败，绝不静默。 本仓库风格是带原因的显式错误压过安静的默认值： 无效句柄带着可经 get_last_error_message() 读到的消息、过期格式拒绝解析 并提示重新生成、欠解析的运行断言报错而不是产出看着挺像的错数。一个添了 静默回退的贡献是在跟整个代码库对着干。

遵守已记录的契约。 公共 ABI 是 bridge.h；Fortran 界面是 src/julia_binding.f90 与 src/julia_sdk.f90；Julia 侧是 FortranBridge 包。扩展其中任何一个意味着更新它上面那层（以及它的文档页），而不是绕过 它。

机器特征一律脱敏。 示例、脚本、文档不得硬编码本机安装路径、主机名或 用户名——用占位符、环境变量覆盖或可执行文件相邻探测，正如现有代码的做 法。文档门对散文强制这条；代码和注释按同一个标准要求自己。

文档跟着代码走。 用户可见的行为变化要同步更新两个语言的相关页面， 并把 sync 戳前移。改了某道门查什么的 PR，在同一提交序列里更新 验收门。

每个说法都有出处。 文档与注释里的数字来自验证运行，出处到产出它的脚 本；你改了一个数字的来源，就改这个数字。没有出处的测量是未来某个人的错 误假设。

docs.title: Pull request
docs.text:
向主分支（main）开 PR，附上：

  • 改动做什么、为什么（有 issue 就带上链接）；
  • 你跑了哪些门、哨兵输出是什么；
  • 动了 src/bridge/ 的，说明为什么桥内部的 GC 与 线程规则对你的改动仍然成立。

评审会聚焦这个项目在乎的失败模式：错误路径覆盖、static 缓存的 GC 扎根、 版本钉死、诚实的文档。如果评审人要你补跑一道你跳过的门，那正是评审在按 设计工作——收据见教训。

docs.title: 延伸阅读

docs.title: 接下来去哪
docs.text: 没有下游了——你已经到书架跟前。回到开发者指南， 或看本站自己的验证故事。

docs.title: 教训
docs.text: 这个代码库里的每条规则都是付过钱的。本页是收据抽屉：守卫、钉死、以及你 维护桥时会遇到的响亮失败背后的那些事故。每条都按同一个形状写——症状、 根因、修复、留下的规则。涉事的机器与账户刻意匿名；能迁移的是机制。

docs.title: 1. 任何比较的两边都要钉死 Julia 运行时
docs.text:
症状。 四道 GRI 验收门（验收门）开始报出 1e-9 量级的非零余量——时过时不过——而桥和化学都没改过。看得见的嫌疑人 是桥的数组提取。

根因。 版本错位，不是 bug。桥可执行文件内嵌构建钉死的 libjulia 1.12.7，而原生基准是用裸 julia 重新生成的——那是一个自动更新的版本 shim，上游一发版就悄然指向 1.13.2。同一个刚性求解、两个不同 Julia 版本 各跑一遍，点火过渡段就会漂移——实测逐点达 T rel 1.5e-5、CH4 rel 0.54——轻松跨过 1e-8 的门。调查先追了求解器非确定性与 BLAS 线程归约顺 序；用钉死二进制重新生成基准，四个偏差精确归零，结案。

修复。 现在有两道守卫响亮拒绝错位：run_gri_native.jl 除非 VERSION == v"1.12.7" 否则报错；FJ_BUILD_SYSIMAGE 的 CMake 守卫在配置 期拒绝一切 1.12.x 线以外的构建 Julia，并点名版本 shim 是不能用的东西。

规则。 任何 A/B 比较——基准 vs 桥、改前 vs 改后——两边用同一个钉死 二进制。紧门 flake 时，先审计运行时，再查代码。

docs.title: 2. 用 [compat] 钉死 SciML 栈
docs.text:
症状。 capstone 的每格化学开销突然暴涨约 700 倍：冻结网格格走 982 步积分器内步而不是 1 步，燃烧格约 5.4 万步而不是约 100 步，每格分配约 3.5 MB。nx = 400 时化学阶段跑 89 s，而受测栈只需 1.25 s。

根因。 草稿环境漂移到了 OrdinaryDiffEq 7.x 线上，因为动力学包当时不 带 [compat] 边界。7.x 的步长控制器处理每格 reinit! / step! 模式要 差得多——一个”解析成功”的依赖，跑起来很糟。

修复。 包的 [compat] 现在钉死受测线——Catalyst ~16.2、 OrdinaryDiffEq ~6.111、SciMLBase ~2.155、StaticArrays ~1.9、 PrecompileTools ~1.3——删掉未用的 ModelingToolkit 直接依赖，环境装配脚本 写明这些钉死为何载重。

规则。 数值依赖一律钉死；吞吐无缘无故退化时，先打印解析出的版本再 profile。”能解析”不等于”能干活”；resolver 优化的是兼容性，不是你的访问 模式。

docs.title: 3. 永远不要关掉 Julia 的信号处理
docs.text:
症状。 接启动选项时，把 jl_options.handle_signals = OFF 看成让嵌 入运行时不抢宿主应用信号处理器的干净办法。进程随后在 GC safepoint 崩 溃——15 次运行里 14 次。

根因。 嵌入式 Julia 的 GC safepoint 轮询依赖 Julia 自己的 SIGSEGV 处 理器；关掉信号处理等于拆掉运行时自己要用的机器。崩溃是必现的、不是竞态 ——至少它好复现。

修复。 桥永不写 jl_options.handle_signals。它本要满足的需求（”别 接管我的信号”）换了个满足法：fcj_options_t 里的 handle_signals = 0 含义是不接管——init 成功后桥把 SIGINT / SIGTERM 重置为 SIG_DFL， GC 关键的处理器原封不动。

规则。 把 jl_options 当只读。需要宿主友好的信号处置，就在 init 后 重置具体信号；永远不要从 Julia 脚下抽走它自己的处理器。

docs.title: 4. 共享集群上：以退出码判作业，别看 stdout
docs.text:
症状。 在共享集群上经 Slurm 的 srun 启动的批作业会间歇性地把整段 stdout 打印两遍——整块逐字重复、跨独立运行复现、作业本身一切健康。裸的 shell echo 也能复现；没有环境变量或节点设置解释得了它。

根因。 启动层的集群 I/O 怪象，不是被跑程序的错。它是传输层噪声，作 业内部修不了。

修复与规则。 自动化判定一律以退出码和测试汇总行为准，绝不以日志 读起来像什么为准；日志归档或续传时先去重（awk '!seen[$0]++' 是本仓库 的惯用语）。解析 Slurm 日志找哨兵串并据此行动时，永远为重复留出余量—— 也别让一份看着重复的日志说服你作业跑了两遍。

docs.title: 5. 一个首次运行就下载 570 MB 的”自含”AOT 库
docs.text:
症状。 一座 PackageCompiler 构建、宣称自含的库，第一次初始化花在网 络抓取上——约 570 MB（IntelOpenMP / oneTBB / MKL）——发生在一台没有包 depot 的机器上。

根因。 SciML 闭包里的一个依赖在镜像加载时探测 MKL_jll——一个 惰性 artifact。PackageCompiler 默认只捆绑非惰性 artifact，于是”你要的 一切”悄悄变成了”除惰性以外的一切”。

修复。 构建带 include_lazy_artifacts = true；capstone 的 AOT 构建 脚本原样带着解释此事的注释。验证方式是老实的那种：在空 JULIA_DEPOT_PATH 和全新 home 目录下初始化——零网络访问。

规则。 “自含”是可检验的命题——用空 depot 和断网路径检验它，而不是 读自己的构建脚本。

docs.title: 6. AOT 库拥有自己的运行时：走它自己的正门
docs.text:
症状。 把编译出的 Julia 库链进一个同时用桥 SDK 的进程——能链上—— 直到初始化段错误，或者以指向四面八方的方式行为异常。

根因。 编译出的库捆绑自己的 libjulia，而进程现在对运行时住在哪有 了两套意见。调 SDK 的 julia_init() 走的是裸 jl_init()，它会找捆绑布 局里根本没有的默认 sys.so——sysimage 是编译进库里的，只有它导出的 init_julia 知道怎么加载它（带显式 bindir）。

修复。 AOT 模式下，生命周期只走库导出的 init_julia / shutdown_julia，别无他途。接口声明在 src/lib_support/julia_library_interface.f90，工作示例 （examples/03_deployment/2_compiled_library/、 examples/07_capstone/3_aot_kinetics/）展示了这个模式。

规则。 一个进程、一个运行时所有者。库自带 Julia 时，生命周期入口是 那个库的导出函数——不是 SDK 的。

docs.title: 接下来去哪
docs.text:
• 验收门——这些事故留下的守卫，以及怎么跑它们。
  • 从零重建——三条重建配方，条目 1、2、5 的钉死与开关都已 就位。
  • 已知限制——属于设计而非 bug 的那些老 实边界。

docs.title: 从零重建
docs.text:
仓库里有三样东西是构建产物而不是源码：SciML sysimage、AOT 化学库、 capstone 图集。三样都能在全新克隆上从零重生成——本页就是各自的配方，含 让重建保持老实的守卫与开关。路径一律相对仓库根；凡提到 Julia 二进制，用 钉死的 1.12.7 安装，不要用版本 shim（教训条目 1）。

前两步的共同前置是钉死的草稿环境 scripts/sysimage_env。 scripts/install_sciml_env.jl 装配它（把 FortranBridge 与动力学包 dev 进 去、经 [compat] 钉死解析）；用桥所内嵌的同一个 1.12.x Julia 跑它。

docs.title: 第一步：SciML sysimage
docs.text:
sysimage 是把 17.3 s 的 JIT 启动换成 1.90 s 加载的东西 （交付形态）。Julia 侧包的形状一变就要重 建它。两个入口、一个结果：

    cmake -B build -DFJ_BUILD_SYSIMAGE=ON ...
    cmake --build build --target fcj_sysimage

配置步会跑版本守卫：FJ_BUILD_SYSIMAGE 只接受 1.12.x 的构建 Julia，否则 配置失败并给出明确信息——sysimage 被钉死在制作它的那个 Julia 构建与构建 主机的指令集上（cpu_target = "native"），所以它按设计就是单机产物。

烤进去什么由 scripts/build_sysimage.jl 决定。核心调用逐字如下：

create_sysimage(
    ["FortranBridge", "SciMLBase", "OrdinaryDiffEq", "FjKinetics"],
    project = sysimage_env,
    sysimage_path = output_path,
    precompile_execution_file = precompile_path,
    cpu_target = "native", # single-host embedding: bake the build host's ISA
)

precompile_execution_file（scripts/precompile.jl，加各包自带的 PrecompileTools 负载）追踪到的一切都进镜像——刻意包含 plain 数组与 view 两条 step_chemistry! 路径，使 Fortran 驱动每半步 eval 的那次调用 在运行时永不编译。预期一个大文件（这套 SciML 负载的镜像约 1 GB）与以几十 分钟计的构建。

docs.title: 第二步：AOT 化学库
docs.text:
生产形态的 AOT 构建住在 examples/07_capstone/3_aot_kinetics/：一个小 Julia 包（KineticsAOT）暴露 Base.@ccallable 内核，由 PackageCompiler 的 create_library 编译进一个自带运行时的 dist/。在该目录下用钉死 Julia 跑 build_lib.jl；其核心调用逐字如下（注释保留——它是用一次事故 换来的警告）：

create_library("KineticsAOT", "dist";
    lib_name = "libkinetics",
    force = true,
    header_files = ["kinetics.h"],
    incremental = false,
    filter_stdlibs = true,
    # LinearSolve (SciML closure) probes MKL_jll, a lazy artifact, at
    # image load -- without bundling it the library downloads ~570 MB
    # from the network on first init, breaking self-containedness.
    include_lazy_artifacts = true,
    precompile_execution_file = ["aot_precompile.jl"],
)

为它留预算：整个闭包的非增量代码生成以小时和几十 GB 编译器峰值内存计， dist/ 约 2.5 GB。自含性用老实的办法验证——在空 JULIA_DEPOT_PATH 与全 新 home 目录下初始化，确认零网络访问（教训条目 5）。并记 住同页的生命周期规则：消费方走库导出的 init_julia，绝不走 SDK 的 julia_init。

examples/03_deployment/2_compiled_library/ 里的小兄弟（MyLib）以教程规 模演示同一模式；dist/ 一旦存在，CMake 构建自动加它的 MyLib 目标。

docs.title: 第三步：capstone 图集
docs.text:
examples/07_capstone/figures/ 下的图全部由一个脚本从五份 CSV 渲染；没 有任何图是手改的。流水线：

  1. 生成数据。 跑两个 capstone 可执行文件 （ex_capstone_reacting_flow、ex_capstone_gri_ignition）与原生基准 （run_gri_native.jl，钉死二进制——叠合桥与原生的那张图继承基准的运 行时）。它们把 output/*.csv 写在示例旁。
  2. 渲染。 在 examples/07_capstone/figures/ 下：
    python3 plot_capstone.py

脚本的 main() 从 ../output/*.csv 渲染整套图（fig1 到 fig8），画前断 言每份文件的列契约，PNG 与 PDF 双输出。缺 CSV 或 CSV 过期会响亮失败，而 不是画出空轴。每张图讲什么、被哪些 QA 规则约束，记录在 examples/07_capstone/figures/FIGURES.md。

docs.title: 改动之后的重建顺序
docs.text: 一句顺序上的实话：源码改动只向前传播。桥或 Fortran 改动需要普通重建加 验收门；Julia 侧包改动额外需要第一步（AOT 路径要紧的话再加第二步）；影 响数据的改动需要先重跑示例，第三步才画得出新东西。跳步不会响亮失败—— 只会无声地画出错误运行的图。

docs.title: 仓库导览
docs.text: 先给你地图，再看地形。本页从仓库顶层走到真正要紧的文件，说明每块东西是 干什么的，并指向深入讲它的页面。这里读一遍即可；之后用站内搜索就够了。

docs.title: 顶层一览
docs.text: 条目 是什么 src/bridge/ 桥的 C 心脏：8 个文件、约 105 个导出的 fcj_* 符号（桥内部） src/FortranBridge/ Julia 侧包：FortranBridge.jl 之下的 5 个子模块 src/julia_binding.f90 julia_low_level：覆盖 fcj_* C ABI 的 bind(c) 真相本体 src/julia_sdk.f90 julia_high_level：type(JuliaValue)、装箱、转换器、%to_fortran src/lib_support/ Fortran 支撑类型与 AOT 库接口声明 examples/ 7 个编号示例族，01_basics 到 07_capstone，另有 legacy/ scripts/ 环境装配、sysimage 构建、预编译负载、文档工具 docs/ 本双语 MkDocs 站点（en 默认，zh 镜像） tests/ 站点双语对拍测试（test_docs_parity.py）——文档门，不是物理门 CMakeLists.txt 构建：fcj_middleware 静态库、示例、FJ_BUILD_SYSIMAGE README.md 通向本文档站点的大门：两个语言的入口、头条数字与本地构建配方 requirements*.txt 文档构建（-docs）与开发工具（-dev）的 Python 依赖

docs.title: src/：三种语言写成的桥
docs.text:
src/bridge/——C。 可嵌入核心。8 个 .c 文件分四个职责组：核心生命 周期（core.c、memory.c）、分发与装箱（dispatch.c、types.c）、数组 通道（arrays.c、extract.c）、回调访问（callbacks.c、accessors.c）。 两个头文件划定界面：bridge.h 是公共契约（53 个 fcj_ 函数加 fcj_options_t），bridge_internal.h 是私有的（原生元素访问器、各模块清 缓存钩子）。维护者需要的一切都在桥内部。

src/FortranBridge/——Julia。 嵌入运行时加载的包。src/FortranBridge/ src/FortranBridge.jl 之下有五个子模块：

子模块 职责 GCManager.jl Julia 侧根注册表（Main.FJ_ROOTS 回退路径、引用计数） FunctionRegistry.jl 名字到函数的注册表、Fast Path 的 @cfunction 蹦床 Accessors.jl %element 与 %property 背后的 getfield / getproperty 助手 Callbacks.jl 把 Fortran bind(c) 子程序包装成 Julia 可调用对象 Utilities.jl 共用小工具

src/julia_binding.f90 与 src/julia_sdk.f90——Fortran。 即 两套 SDK，两种速度的两层：低层 bind(c) 声明（58 个符号），与建在其上的高层 OOP 层。src/lib_support/ 放 julia_types.f90 （支撑类型）和 julia_library_interface.f90——AOT 示例链接的 init_julia / shutdown_julia 声明（交付形态）。

docs.title: examples/：编号阶梯
docs.text:
每个家族都比上一个更进一步；编号同时就是推荐阅读顺序。

家族 内容 演示什么 01_basics hello world、quickstart、数组、零拷贝数组、数据结构 第一次调用、数组通道 02_intermediate 数学运算、关键字参数 %call 变体、fcj_call_kwargs 03_deployment init 选项、自定义 sysimage、2_compiled_library/ 启动控制、AOT 04_performance JIT vs AOT、调用开销、内存搬运、访问模式、基准套件 ~815 ns / ~3.8 ns 数字的出处 05_hpc_parallel 多线程（10 万个包装矩阵、一次调用）、MPI 引导 单线程规则内的批量化 06_sciml 回调、批量取数、SciML demo 跨桥的 OrdinaryDiffEq 07_capstone 反应流、GRI 点火、3_aot_kinetics/、FjKinetics/、figures/、PERFORMANCE.md 一切合体，外加验收门

examples/legacy/ 保留包化之前的十一个示例（01_hello.f90 … 11_all_types.f90）供考古；没有任何东西链接它们。 examples/CMakeLists.txt 为每个编号源文件构建一个可执行文件，把 Julia 运 行时和项目拷到可执行文件旁，并在 dist/ 存在时加入 MyLib AOT 演示。

docs.title: scripts/：维护工具
docs.text:
文件 角色 install_sciml_env.jl 创建 scripts/sysimage_env 并把钉死的 SciML 栈装配进去 build_sysimage.jl PackageCompiler create_sysimage，覆盖 FortranBridge + SciMLBase + OrdinaryDiffEq + FjKinetics precompile.jl 被追踪进 sysimage 的预编译负载 docs_parity.py、docs_leak_patterns.txt 本站要过的双语对拍与泄漏门

前三个脚本背后的钉死环境故事见从零重建；钉死为什么存在，见 教训。

docs.title: docs/、tests/ 与站点门
docs.text: docs/ 放 en/（默认语言）与 zh/（镜像）。 tests/test_docs_parity.py 驱动 scripts/docs_parity.py：每个页面必须在两个语言下都存在、标题已翻译、 sync 戳一致，且任何页面都不得泄漏机器特征串（本机路径、主机名）——也 正是散文页写作时遵守的同一条脱敏规则。

docs.title: 接下来去哪
docs.text:
• 桥内部——8 个 C 文件，一组一组，真代码摆在眼前。
  • 验收门——在这里”正确”意味着什么，改动之后如何 重新证明。
  • 贡献指南——把一次导览变成一个 pull request。

docs.title: 架构
docs.text: FortranCallJulia 是同一进程里的三个世界：Fortran 应用、C 桥、被嵌入的 Julia 运行时。Fortran 侧从不直接触碰 Julia API；Julia 侧也看不到任何 Fortran 声明。二者交换的一切都经由 fcj_* C ABI 通过。本页自上而下过一遍各层，然后给出整个系统的交互式架构图。

docs.title: Fortran 世界
docs.text:
这里的一切都随你的可执行文件由 gfortran 编入：

  • 应用层——示例 01 至 07，从第一次 fcj_init 调用一直到两个收官可执行文件（reacting_flow、gri_ignition）。
  • julia_high_level——面向对象的 SDK：带 GC 安全生命周期的 JuliaValue 句柄、字段/属性导航（%element、%property）、批量取数（%to_fortran，一次调用取回整个数组）。
  • julia_low_level——fcj_* 声明的 bind(c) 层，面向想要最少抽象的调用方。Fast Path 就在这里：裸函数指针，每次调用约 3.8 ns，而泛型分发路径约 815 ns。

docs.title: C 桥接层
docs.text:
src/bridge，8 个 C 源文件编成 fcj_middleware.a，导出约 105 个 fcj_* 符号。四类职责，四个模块对：

模块对 职责 core.c + memory.c 生命周期（fcj_init / fcj_init_ex / 退出）、线程检查（check_thread()）、GC 根集（fcj_map） dispatch.c + types.c 泛型调用（fcj_call*、关键字参数）与全类型标量装箱（fcj_box_*） arrays.c + extract.c N 维零拷贝 wrap 与深拷贝 copy；结果批量回流 Fortran callbacks.c + accessors.c @cfunction 蹦床（Julia 调 Fortran）与对活动对象的字段/属性访问

docs.title: Julia 世界
docs.text:
• libjulia 1.12.7，钉死。 官方 jl_* C API，进程内嵌入。版本钉死并非例行公事：对拍基线必须与桥内嵌的 Julia 同版本，否则残差毫无意义。
  • FortranBridge.jl——五个模块（GCManager、FunctionRegistry、Accessors、Callbacks、Utilities），实现 ABI 的 Julia 侧。
  • FjKinetics.jl v0.2——AbstractKineticsSolver，提供 OneStepSolver（OrdinaryDiffEq，FBDF / Rodas5P）与 GriSolver 两种前端。
  • SciML 栈，compat 钉死——Catalyst 16、OrdinaryDiffEq 6、SciMLBase 2。钉死的原因：这些包之间无约束的版本漂移会悄悄损害性能与可复现性。
  • ChemMechSim.jl——机理输入；提供 GRI-Mech 3.0，53 物种 / 325 反应。已开源；本文验证使用 v1.2.0。

docs.title: 一次调用的路径
docs.text:
前向调用走四跳，每一跳之后都检查异常标志：

Fortran bind(c) 调用方
  -> fcj_* 入口（分发、装箱、根集记账）
     -> jl_call* / jl_box_*（libjulia C API）
        -> Julia 方法（FortranBridge.jl 或用户代码）

反方向对称：julia_callback 把 Fortran 子程序包进 @cfunction 蹦床，OrdinaryDiffEq 求解器便能在每一步调用 Fortran 右端项。任何一跳失败，调用返回错误码，get_last_error_message() 把 Julia 错误文本带回调用方。

交付形态原样叠加在这条路径之上：同样的调用可按 JIT（冷启动 17.3 s）、sysimage（1.90 s）或 AOT（首次调用约 12 μs）运行，见交付形态。

docs.title: 验证
docs.text: 本站出现的每个标志性数字都来自一道真实运行过的验收门，而不是设计意图。三道头条门锚定整个项目——其中第二道本身捆着四道内部门：每道门都把桥与一个独立基线相比，而且只有当双方运行同一个钉死的 Julia 1.12.7 时才算数——跨 Julia 版本的比较测的是版本漂移，不是桥。

docs.title: 门一：CJ 爆速
docs.text:
反应流收官示例（reacting_flow）模拟 Chapman–Jouguet 爆轰：Fortran Euler 驱动器 + 内嵌 Clawpack 核，经 Strang 分裂与 Catalyst 化学耦合。

量 值 仿真 CJ 爆速 7.12391 解析 CJ 爆速 7.12470 偏差 0.011%

仿真波速与解析 CJ 值的偏差仅 0.011%，意味着算子分裂、分裂内部的桥穿越、以及 Julia 化学积分器，全部在离散误差范围内保持物理不损。

docs.title: 门二：桥接对原生——四道内部门零偏差
docs.text:
GRI 点火算例（gri_ignition）运行两遍：一遍过桥，一遍作为原生 Julia 基线。四道内部验收门比较输出。

设定 结果 双方 Julia 版本 1.12.7（钉死） 比较的门数 4 发现的偏差 0 残差 < 1e-12

低于 1e-12 的残差已到浮点非结合性消失、精确一致开始的量级：桥没有改变任何算术。

为什么版本钉死是指标的一部分

早先一次对拍失败，原因与桥毫无关系：一个版本垫片把 Julia 静默解析到了与桥内嵌版本不同的 minor 版本上，基线随之漂移。自那以后，每次比较的双方都钉死同一个 1.12.7 二进制。

docs.text:
同一套机构计算 GRI-Mech 3.0 均相混合气（53 物种、325 反应）的点火延迟：

  • t_ign = 1.1075 ms，取 argmax |dT/dt|——最大放热率时刻，这是不依赖阈值约定的标准锐利定义。

docs.title: FortranCallJulia 是什么？
docs.text:
FortranCallJulia 把 Julia 运行时嵌入 Fortran 应用程序——同一进程、同一可执行文件。Fortran 代码经由一层薄 C 桥（fcj_* C ABI，约 105 个符号）调用 Julia；Julia 再通过 @cfunction 蹦床回调 Fortran，于是一个 bind(c) Fortran 子程序可以直接充当 OrdinaryDiffEq 积分的右端项。

三个世界共同编入最终二进制：

世界 内容 Fortran 应用本体：驱动器、水力学、主循环。示例 01–07，由双层 SDK（julia_high_level / julia_low_level）封装。 C 桥 src/bridge——8 个 C 源文件编成 fcj_middleware.a。负责 GC 根集、参数装箱、数组、回调、错误检查。 Julia libjulia 1.12.7（钉死）、FortranBridge.jl、FjKinetics.jl v0.2、compat 钉死的 SciML 栈、ChemMechSim.jl。

docs.title: 能用它做什么
docs.text:
• 从 Fortran 调 Julia。 求值表达式、带关键字参数调用函数、装箱任意类型的标量——全部通过 bind(c) 声明的 fcj_* 调用完成，构建树里不出现任何生成代码。
  • 数组零拷贝传递。 N 维 Fortran 数组原地包装成 Julia 数组；结果零拷贝回流，或经批量取数接口返回（%to_fortran 一次调用拷回整个稠密数组）。
  • 从 Julia 调 Fortran。 julia_callback 把 bind(c) 子程序包装成 Julia 可调用对象——例如被 OrdinaryDiffEq 消费的 ODE 右端项。
  • 选择交付形态。 同一份源码可按 JIT、sysimage 或 AOT 方式运行，见交付形态。
  • 响亮地失败。 每次桥调用都做异常检查；失败经 get_last_error_message() 报出，而不是悄悄退化成错误答案。

docs.title: 定义本项目的数字
docs.text:
• 开销。 Fast Path 调用（裸 C 函数指针，面向紧循环）约 3.8 ns，泛型调用路径约 815 ns（10 万次迭代平均）。
  • 启动阶梯。 JIT 冷启动到首个结果 17.3 s；sysimage 降到 1.90 s；AOT 版本首次调用约 12 μs，逼近原生基线。
  • 正确性。 CJ 爆速 7.12391，解析值 7.12470（偏差 0.011%）；桥接对原生在四道验收门上 0 偏差；GRI 点火延迟 t_ign = 1.1075 ms。出处与背景见验证。
